verses.english: Numbered Discourses 3.3
1. Fools
Thinking
“There are these three characteristics, signs, and manifestations of a fool.
What three?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, bālo duccintitacintī ca hoti dubbhāsitabhāsī ca dukkaṭakammakārī ca.
verses.english: A fool thinks poorly, speaks poorly, and acts poorly.

verses.pali: No cedaṁ, bhikkhave, bālo duccintitacintī ca abhavissa dubbhāsitabhāsī ca dukkaṭakammakārī ca, kena naṁ paṇḍitā jāneyyuṁ:
verses.english: If a fool didn’t think poorly, speak poorly, and act poorly, then how would the astute know of them:
‘This worthy one is a fool, an untrue person’?

verses.pali: Yasmā ca kho, bhikkhave, bālo duccintitacintī ca hoti dubbhāsitabhāsī ca dukkaṭakammakārī ca tasmā naṁ paṇḍitā jānanti:
verses.english: But since a fool does think poorly, speak poorly, and act poorly, then the astute do know of them:
‘This worthy one is a fool, an untrue person’.

verses.pali: Imāni kho, bhikkhave, tīṇi bālassa bālalakkhaṇāni bālanimittāni bālāpadānāni.
verses.english: These are the three characteristics, signs, and manifestations of a fool.

verses.pali: Tīṇimāni, bhikkhave, paṇḍitassa paṇḍitalakkhaṇāni paṇḍitanimittāni paṇḍitāpadānāni.
verses.english: There are these three characteristics, signs, and manifestations of an astute person.
What three?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, paṇḍito sucintitacintī ca hoti subhāsitabhāsī ca sukatakammakārī ca.
verses.english: An astute person thinks well, speaks well, and acts well.

verses.pali: No cedaṁ, bhikkhave, paṇḍito sucintitacintī ca abhavissa subhāsitabhāsī ca sukatakammakārī ca, kena naṁ paṇḍitā jāneyyuṁ:
verses.english: If an astute person didn’t think well, speak well, and act well, then how would the astute know of them:
‘This worthy one is astute, a true person’?

verses.pali: Yasmā ca kho, bhikkhave, paṇḍito sucintitacintī ca hoti subhāsitabhāsī ca sukatakammakārī ca tasmā naṁ paṇḍitā jānanti:
verses.english: But since an astute person does think well, speak well, and act well, then the astute do know of them:
‘This worthy one is astute, a true person’.

verses.pali: Imāni kho, bhikkhave, tīṇi paṇḍitassa paṇḍitalakkhaṇāni paṇḍitanimittāni paṇḍitāpadānāni.
verses.english: These are the three characteristics, signs, and manifestations of an astute person.
So you should train …”
